scope: Mundari-language audiovisual/audio manifestations; source-level discovery only until rights/provenance/consent gates pass

records.title: Gospel of Mark • Mundari (unr)
records.version: 2018 The Word for the World International (2020 Audio)

canonicalization.rule: Each provider reference number is a source manifestation identity. Provider landing page, sample/player URL, device-load manifestation and mirrors must not be counted as independent corroborating sources without provenance establishing independence.
canonicalization.cross_source_rule: Religious recordings or translations derived from a shared textual/translation source must be dependency-linked before evidentiary use.

gates: verify item-level licence and redistribution/research permissions
obtain lawful immutable bytes where permitted and record SHA-256
review participant consent, privacy and culturally restricted-content implications
establish transcript/source-text dependency and exact item/timecode locators
do not infer dialect from provider alternate-language labels
do not promote religious narrative content as independent cultural fact
audit_note: Provider metadata is sufficient for deterministic discovery identity and exact provider reference locators, but not for linguistic/cultural evidence promotion. Public streaming/sample availability is not treated as reuse permission or participant consent.
